Attending this podcast while declining to cooperate with the CIDG sends a clear message that these individuals are not genuinely committed to helping uncover the truth behind the deaths of their two teammates.

It also raises questions about the platform itself. The interviewer is an alumnus of the same institution that has been criticized for its lack of transparency and accountability regarding this case.
